title: Compare and Order Integers and Rational Numbers

items.stem: Sarah has the following temperatures recorded in degrees Celsius: -8°, 3°, -2°, and 0°. Which list correctly orders the temperatures from coldest to warmest?
Select ALL statements that are true about comparing rational numbers.
choices: A larger positive number is always greater than a smaller positive number.
Between two negative numbers, the one with the greater absolute value is always greater.
Zero is greater than any negative number.
When comparing fractions, convert them to decimals or common denominators to order them accurately.

items.stem: Compare the numbers -3/4 and -2/3. Which number is greater? Show or explain your work to support your answer.
